'''''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Deluge''''' is the second miniseries in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'' comic series]] comic series. It occurs in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] in the [[Republic Dark Age]] during the last century of the [[New Sith Wars]] and is largely narrated through the point of view of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], a knight errant [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who operated in Sith territory. This story arc deals with Kerra's return to her homeworld of [[Aquilaris Minor]] following the events of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]. She becomes caught up in a complex three-way power struggle involving the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] lord [[Zodoh]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grace Command]] with significant ramifications for the wider [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. A substantial part of the plot also deals with Kerra's relationships with her old childhood friend [[Joad Kreel]] and the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]].

''Deluge'' was first released on [[August 17]], [[2011]] and ran through to [[December 21]], [[2011]]. It consisted of five issues, and its script was developed by [[John Jackson Miller]]. ''Deluge'' was subsequently collected as a [[Star Wars: Knight Errant Volume 2: Deluge|trade paperback comic]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 30]], [[2012]].
